about.dates: The dates are picked at harvest, sorted by hand and packed within days. Keep them in a cool, dry place and they stay soft for months.
about.coffee: The coffee is roasted in small batches and packed the same week. Store it in a closed jar away from light and heat to keep its aroma.
about.incense: Each piece is blended and dried by hand. Burn it on a lit charcoal disc and keep the container closed between uses.
about.pottery: Every piece is shaped on the wheel and fired in a local kiln, so size and colour vary a little. Wash it by hand with mild soap.
about.baskets: The palm fronds are cut, dried and woven by hand, which gives each piece its own pattern. Wipe it with a dry cloth and keep it out of damp places.
about.weaving: The wool is spun and dyed locally, then woven on a ground loom in traditional Sadu patterns. Spot clean it gently and avoid strong sunlight.

about.title: About Souq Al-Hiraf
body: Souq Al-Hiraf is a small online market for Saudi crafts and local products. We work with farms, roasters, potters and weavers across the Kingdom and pay them a fair price for their work.
Every item is chosen by our team. We pack each order by hand and ship it from Riyadh.

shipping.title: Shipping and returns
shipping.intro: Everything about how we send your order and what to do if something is not right.

sections.title: Delivery times
body: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 working days from the day we confirm your payment. Working days are Sunday to Thursday.
Orders placed after 2 pm start on the next working day. Remote areas can take one extra day, and we show the expected date on the tracking page.

sections.title: Shipping fees
body: Shipping costs 25 SAR for each order, however many items it holds. It is free when the order total is above 300 SAR.
The FREESHIP coupon also removes the shipping fee. The fee is shown in your cart before you pay.

sections.title: Express delivery
body: Express delivery adds 35 SAR and brings your order the next working day. It is available in Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Makkah and Madinah.
Orders paid before 2 pm leave the same day. Express orders cannot include large items such as rugs.
If we miss the express date, we refund the express fee.

sections.title: Cash on delivery
body: You can pay the courier in cash when the order arrives. This adds a 10 SAR fee to the order.
Please keep the exact amount ready. The courier may not have change.

sections.title: Tracking your order
body: Every order has a tracking page that shows each step, from payment to delivery. Open it from your order confirmation.
When the courier collects the parcel, the page shows the courier name and a tracking number that you can copy.
The page updates by itself every few seconds while the order is on its way.

sections.title: Returns
body: You can return unused items in their original packaging within 7 days of delivery. Write to us with your order number and we send you a return label.
Food, incense and perfume oils cannot be returned once opened, unless they arrive damaged. Gift boxes can be returned only as a whole.

sections.title: Refunds
body: We refund returned items to the original payment method within 5 to 10 working days of receiving them. Cash on delivery orders are refunded by bank transfer.
The shipping fee is not refunded unless the return is our mistake.

sections.title: Damaged or missing items
body: If something arrives damaged or is missing, tell us within 48 hours and attach a photo. We send a replacement or refund you, whichever you prefer.
Keep the outer box until we have solved the problem. It helps us claim from the courier.

contact.title: Contact us
body: Write to us and we will reply within two working days. You can also reach us at care@hiraf.example or 800 123 4567, Sunday to Thursday, 9 am to 5 pm.
